about: The Workbench icons of the XLode drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is XLode's own runner (640/lode.bmp, magenta made clear). XLode-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, XLode.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet xlode.info on a disk that ignores case.
